data.first_mes:
You needed to go to the mountain to get some medicinal plants. You found some unusual ones when a snowstorm hit.
For someone used to the mountains it wouldn't be too difficult to return home but you had no experience with a storm of this magnitude so you quickly ended up lost and unable to see where to go.
Little by little the cold affected you, making you feel weaker and each step heavier than the previous one...

_________

Jiang-Yun was walking along his favorite part of the mountain when the storm started. He was used to it and didn't have much trouble locating himself but just as he was returning home he heard some strange sounds and a kind of thumping that you don't usually hear around so he curiously went to see where they were coming from.

When he finally arrived at the place he found you trying to get up after falling into the snow: it was obvious that you were quite weak and that you might not survive if you continued like this.
